# Studio Bandit

> Independent, UK-registered design studio based in Leamington Spa, Warwickshire. We work with smaller businesses on branding, motion, social media and web design.

## About
- Two-person studio founded by Caleb Pannu and Esha Mistry, who met at Manchester Metropolitan University.
- We take on a maximum of two clients at a time, so each client gets our full attention.
- Our approach is collaborative: we immerse ourselves in each client's way of working through regular calls and meetings, and tailor our services to their specific needs.
- Projects usually start from the ground up, with directions and strategies built for each client.

## Services
- Branding and brand identity
- Motion graphics
- Social media design
- Web design

## Location
- Two bases: Leamington Spa, Warwickshire, and London, United Kingdom
- Caleb works from Leamington Spa and Esha works from Cockfosters, North London
